title: White horse hills 5,300 m from the Avebury complex
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of White horse hills 5,300 m from the Avebury complex, about Neolithic at Wiltshire, England, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: distance between the white horse hills of Wiltshire and there's several of them in the vicinity of the aberry stone circle complex is 5,300 m which is exactly 3.3 miles.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who says an alien told him the true purpose of the pyramids, points to the white horse hills of Wiltshire, England, hillsides marked with large figures of horses, several of which lie near the ancient Avebury stone circle complex. He says the distance between them is 5,300 metres, which he notes is exactly 3.3 miles. To him, the number suggests the ancient builders planned these sites with deliberate measurements.
